# Chavez Air Conditioner Service

> Air conditioning & heating based in Killeen, Texas. Chavez Air Conditioner Service repairs and replaces AC and heating in Killeen. Reviewers say Mr. Chavez picks up when others don't, often arrives within the hour, and is honest about what you need.

## Services
- AC repair & diagnostics: Full diagnostics, Freon recharges and part swaps, often within an hour of your call.
- AC system replacement: Condensers, air handlers and packaged units replaced and running, often the next morning.
- Heating & furnaces: Furnace repair and new furnace installs before the cold nights arrive.
- Air duct cleaning: Duct cleaning to clear dust and keep air moving through the house.
- Rentals, commercial & refrigeration: Service for landlords, businesses and refrigeration equipment around Killeen.

## About
Chavez Air Conditioner Service is run by Jorge Chavez in Killeen. Customers call him Mr. Chavez, Jorge or George, and they deal with him directly, with technician Ruben on some jobs. He has more than 20 years of HVAC experience, and Spanish is spoken. The work covers AC repair and replacement, heating and furnaces, duct cleaning and refrigeration for homes, rentals and businesses. The phone is answered early and late, open daily until 10 PM, and reviewers describe Saturday and Sunday visits that started within an hour of calling.

- Q: Do you come out on weekends in Killeen?

  A: Often within an hour. One customer called at 7 AM and had Chavez at the house by 9.

  A: Yes. Se habla español.

  A: Daily, until 10 PM.
